contracts.version: Cloudflare API v4, application id 31bde92e... on domain vantage.insta.host
reject_conditions: The Access application cannot be read or deleted with the stored credential
The deployed build does not prove public_demo, every guard enabled, and the expected version and release commit at the ORIGIN before the gate is removed
Removing the application would leave the service unreachable because tunnel ingress or DNS is absent
The deployed build does not re-prove the same claims through the public hostname after the gate is removed
An authenticated route answers anything other than 401 to an anonymous public caller
The verifier cannot distinguish a gated service from an ungated one
The gate-restoration path can be stopped by an exception, an interrupt or an API rejection before it has exhausted its attempts
The expected version and release commit are optional rather than required for the public stage
contracts.evidence: GET of the live application id answers HTTP 200 with domain vantage.insta.host. Both verifier halves were proven to fail before deployment: origin_guards_live('1.1.0') answered (False, 'the deployed build does not report public_demo at the origin') against the running 1.0.0 build, and public_guards_live() answered (False, '/api/public/config did not return JSON') against the still-gated hostname because Cloudflare Access served its sign-in page. The gate is therefore only ever deleted for a build already proven at the origin, and any post-delete failure, exception or interrupt runs a retrying, read-back-confirmed restoration. The restoration path and the verifier are covered by 17 tests in tests/test_publishctl.py, driving API rejection, transport failure, KeyboardInterrupt, a disagreeing policy readback, a disabled guard, a wrong commit, an unlabelled build, a missing security header and an authenticated route answering anonymously. Mutation run: reverting the BaseException catch and the mandatory identity flags failed exactly those two tests.
